text: Distinguish the control plane from the data plane.
choices: The control plane decides what the table contains, in software over milliseconds; the data plane uses it, in hardware at line rate
Control plane is management access; data plane is user traffic
Control plane is Layer 2; data plane is Layer 3
explanation: The separation is why a router can run an expensive OSPF recalculation while forwarding at full speed, and why a control-plane failure often leaves traffic flowing while the network slowly becomes wrong.
